title: GNUS Agentic Memory Layer (GAML v1)
summary: Defines the GNUS Agentic Memory Layer (GAML v1): structured long-term memory via MemoryObject and Cognitive Asset models, privacy-scoped ingestion, staged retrieval, CRDT replication, and swarm consensus.
notes: No frontmatter and no filename convention; content signals only.
